text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Dants Flame—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Paka Petit! These have gotten super 
popular lately~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Dantsu Flame 
pointed, there was a claw machine filled 
with plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes! My classmates often take on the 
challenge too!
choice_data_list: Have you ever done it too, Dantsu?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I... mostly just watch. I'm not very good 
at it, after all."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
That's why I haven't really won many Paka 
Puchi plushies either.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Still... they really are super cute~. 
Whoa, even the outfit is replicated so 
well...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Prompted by Dants Flame's sparkling eyes, 
I stared intently at the glass display 
case."
choice_data_list:
(...I wonder if there's something they 
want.)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, are you curious about Paka Petit 
too, Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
You were looking at it so intently, so I 
figured there must be something you really 
wanted.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame was just thinking about which 
one she wanted... but they misunderstood 
her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it's a great opportunity. If I'm 
lucky enough to win one, I want to 
surprise her with it as a gift."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, nice challenge! Give it your best, 
Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
